# The Definitive Guide to Building a Very Long Latin Document Title That Will Absolutely Exceed Any Reasonable Card Thumbnail Width On The Home Screen Grid

This corpus verifies how the default title cover handles an extremely long English H1. Latin text wraps at word boundaries, and the cover must keep the title readable without overflowing the card.

## Notes

- The H1 above contains well over one hundred characters;
- Word-boundary wrapping, font step-down, and ellipsis rules apply;
- The cover must stay within the card bounds in both grid and list layouts.
